entities.summary: Lawrence Robert Bowa is an American former professional baseball shortstop, manager, and coach in Major League Baseball (MLB). He played professionally for the Philadelphia Phillies, Chicago Cubs, and the New York Mets. Bowa went on to manage the San Diego Padres and Phillies.
